newsitem.title: UK: Standard Life investment chief resigns - source.
newsitem.headline: Standard Life investment chief resigns - source.

text.p: British Standard Life group's chief investment manager John Thomson has resigned, a source close to the company said.

Thomson, who has held the position at the Edinburgh-based mutual insurance and fund management company since April 1996, was dissatisfied that plans for change had not been implemented, said the source, who declined to be identified.
"He wanted to create a separate investment company to compete against the likes of Mercury Asset Management, but Standard Life wouldn't go along with it," the source said.
A Standard Life official declined to comment.
Standard Life has 52 billion stg under management.
